sharp_question_answer.structural_reason: Any Stokes/divergence rewrite that is not the pure radial one moves the mean onto the codimension-1 kink set K. K carries ~300 signed O(0.1-1) jump terms per random line that cancel to a ~0.03 mean (S9's 196x cancellation-variance factor alone kills at zero enumeration cost), and exact traversal of K is combinatorially forbidden (M86). Also: a PARTIAL surface identity is not available -- S9's addendum shows first-layer-only does NOT close the identity (layer-1 share 0.17-0.49, sign-varying; 20-net mean [-0.54, 0.45, 1.09]).

stokes_plus_fourier_loop.mechanism: Represent ReLU by a frequency-domain/contour representation and close the sphere-mean as a loop integral over frequency: mean ReLU(Z) = E[Z]/2 + (1/pi) * integral (1 - Re phi_Z(t)) / t^2 dt.
